note: Audits P6–P12 specifically: implementation ownership, cardinality, Hokom role, Taaqol role, downstream consumer.

sentence_orchestrator.NOTE: run_qiyas.py builds PipelineLayers with all adapters including SentenceGeometryLayerAdapter, RelationGeometryLayerAdapter, IrabGeometryLayerAdapter, IfadahSpeechForceLayerAdapter. The orchestration driver exists; it requires multi-token input text, not the single-token Hokom pipeline.

layers.HOKOM_INPUT_REQUIREMENT: Hokom produces MufradWordCandidate (P5 output) which is the upstream input for P6; Hokom morphology evidence (CV geometry, n_consonants, vowel cadence) is read from P5 trace
layers.TAAQOL_JUDGMENT_REQUIREMENT: YES — Taaqol enforcer must judge the NORMALIZE→SEGMENT through PHASE_5→TAAQOL_SGA chain before evidence is admissible at P6
layers.ARABIC_VERIFIER_ROLE: HR2S root verdicts contribute to P5 RootStemCandidate which feeds P6 verbal-carrier discrimination

layers.HOKOM_INPUT_REQUIREMENT: Reads P6 VerbalSignifiedCandidate verbal-carrier geometry; Hokom morphology contributes indirectly via P5→P6 chain
Reads P7 composition-readiness geometry; opens dependency-relation POSSIBILITIES (not syntax, not amil/mamul decision). Hokom morphology contributes via full P5→P6→P7 chain.
layers.DOWNSTREAM_CONSUMER: P9_SENTENCE_GEOMETRY (SentenceGeometryCandidate) — collected as SentenceUnit from >=2 distinct words
layers.NOTE: HOKOM CEILING: Hokom single-token pipeline can produce AmilMamulCandidate evidence per word. P9 collects >=2 such units. Hokom cannot orchestrate multi-unit collection; that is Saleh/Qiyas run_qiyas.py responsibility.

layers.HOKOM_INPUT_REQUIREMENT: NONE — Hokom executes single-token. P9 requires >=2 distinct word units each with accepted P8 AmilMamulCandidate. Hokom cannot satisfy the sentence_boundary_closed condition.
layers.TAAQOL_JUDGMENT_REQUIREMENT: YES — RelationCandidate and RelationClosure in Taaqol are FORBIDDEN in Hokom context
layers.ARABIC_VERIFIER_ROLE: NONE at sentence level (no sentence-level corpus annotation exists in LCX-001 through LCX-150)

layers.HOKOM_INPUT_REQUIREMENT: NONE — requires P9 SentenceGeometryCandidate as prerequisite
layers.TAAQOL_JUDGMENT_REQUIREMENT: YES — RelationCandidate in Taaqol native_stage_registry is FORBIDDEN in Hokom context

layers.HOKOM_INPUT_REQUIREMENT: NONE — requires P11 IrabGeometryCandidate; TERMINAL layer (opens no boundary)
layers.TAAQOL_JUDGMENT_REQUIREMENT: YES — Taaqol native_stage_registry marks Ifadah as FORBIDDEN in Hokom context; constitutional law: IfadahCandidate→Action is a FORBIDDEN_LEAP

summary.hokom_ceiling: P8_AMIL_MAMUL — highest SCG layer achievable from Hokom single-token execution
summary.sentence_corpus_required: YES — a sentence-level Arabic corpus with >=2-word units is required to exercise P9-P12; LCX-001 through LCX-150 contain 0 such cases
